#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings Poster
A0 Portrait, 3508×4961 px at 150 DPI
Design Philosophy: Empirical Sublime
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import math

# ── Canvas Setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4961  # A0 portrait at 150 DPI
MARGIN = 180
INNER_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), '#0B1D3A')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY     = (11, 29, 58)       # #0B1D3A — background
SLATE    = (30, 45, 64)       # #1E2D40 — section bg
DARK_SLATE = (22, 34, 50)     # darker slate for contrast
CREAM    = (235, 228, 215)    # warm white for body text
WHITE    = (248, 245, 240)    # bright white for headings
AMBER    = (232, 168, 56)     # #E8A838 — warming accent
VERMILION = (212, 68, 43)     # #D4442B — urgent accent
DEEP_RED = (139, 26, 26)      # #8B1A1A — critical accent
TEAL     = (45, 139, 139)     # #2D8B8B — solution accent
MUTED    = (110, 125, 140)    # muted blue-gray for secondary text
DIM      = (80, 92, 108)      # dim for rules

# ── Font Loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = '/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts'

def load_font(name, size):
    path = os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name)
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

# Preload key fonts at various sizes
font_title      = load_font('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 180)
font_subtitle   = load_font('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 42)
font_section    = load_font('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 52)
font_metric_num = load_font('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 140)
font_metric_num_lg = load_font('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 200)
font_metric_lbl = load_font('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 26)
font_body       = load_font('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 30)
font_body_sm    = load_font('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 24)
font_label      = load_font('Jura-Light.ttf', 22)
font_label_sm   = load_font('Jura-Light.ttf', 18)
font_source     = load_font('Jura-Light.ttf', 16)

def text_size(font, text):
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0], bbox[3] - bbox[1]

def draw_text(draw, xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    """Draw text with anchor support."""
    x, y = xy
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def draw_text_center(draw, x_range, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text horizontally within a range."""
    tw, _ = text_size(font, text)
    cx = (x_range[0] + x_range[1]) / 2 - tw / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_hline(draw, y, x0, x1, color, width=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y + width], fill=color)

def draw_rect(draw, x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):
    if radius == 0:
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=radius, fill=fill)

def draw_frame(draw, x, y, w, h, color, width=1):
    """Draw a thin frame outline."""
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], outline=color, width=width)

# ── Helper: draw a stat callout box ────────────────────────────────────
def stat_box(draw, x, y, w, h, number, label_text, accent_color,
             number_size=140, highlight=False):
    """Draw a metric callout card."""
    # Card background
    card_color = tuple(max(0, c - 8) for c in SLATE) if not highlight else SLATE
    draw_rect(draw, x, y, w, h, card_color, radius=6)
    if highlight:
        # Accent left border
        draw_rect(draw, x, y, 6, h, accent_color, radius=3)

    # Number
    nfont = font_metric_num_lg if highlight else load_font('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', number_size)
    pad_x = 30
    draw_text(draw, (x + pad_x, y + 20), number, nfont, accent_color)

    # Label
    lines = label_text.split('|')
    ly = y + 80 if highlight else y + h - 24 * len(lines) - 16
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        draw_text(draw, (x + pad_x, ly + i * 24), line, font_label_sm, MUTED)

# ── SECTION 1: HEADER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = 0
header_h = 680

# Main background with subtle gradient feel
draw_rect(draw, 0, 0, W, header_h, NAVY)

# Top institutional bar
draw_rect(draw, 0, 0, W, 6, AMBER)
draw_rect(draw, 0, 6, W, 2, VERMILION)

# IPCC logo wordmark area (top left)
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, 50), 'INTERGOVERNMENTAL PANEL ON CLIMATE CHANGE', font_label_sm, MUTED)
draw_hline(draw, 74, MARGIN, MARGIN + 420, DIM, 1)
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, 85), 'AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT  ·  CLIMATE CHANGE 2023', font_label_sm, DIM)

# Title block
title_y = 180
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, title_y), 'CLIMATE CHANGE', font_title, WHITE)
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, title_y + 140), '2023', font_title, AMBER)

# Subtitle
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, title_y + 270),
    'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
    font_subtitle, CREAM)

# Venue line at bottom of header
venue_y = header_h - 60
draw_hline(draw, venue_y, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, DIM, 1)
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, venue_y + 16),
    'PRESENTED AT THE CLIMATE SCIENCE CONFERENCE  ·  AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT DISSEMINATION',
    font_label_sm, MUTED)

y = header_h

# ── Divider band ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_rect(draw, 0, y, W, 3, AMBER)
y += 3

# ── SECTION 2: SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS ─────────────────────────────────
metrics_h = 1050
section_bg_y = y
draw_rect(draw, 0, y, W, metrics_h, SLATE)

# Section label
sec2_label_y = y + 40
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, sec2_label_y), 'ASSESSED METRICS AT A GLANCE', font_label_sm, AMBER)
draw_hline(draw, sec2_label_y + 18, MARGIN, MARGIN + 320, AMBER, 1)

# Grid layout: 7 boxes
# Top row: 4 boxes, Bottom row: 3 boxes (centered, with 43% and 3.3-3.6B larger)
grid_top = y + 90
box_gap = 20
col_w = (INNER_W - 3 * box_gap) / 4

# Top row: 4 metrics
top_metrics = [
    ('1.1°C',  'Global surface temperature|increase (2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900)', VERMILION),
    ('410 ppm','CO₂ concentration in 2019|(highest in 2 million years)', AMBER),
    ('~59',    'Global GHG emissions|in 2019 (GtCO₂-equivalent)', AMBER),
    ('~500',   'Remaining carbon budget|for 1.5°C (50% likelihood, from 2020)', TEAL),
]

for i, (num, lbl, clr) in enumerate(top_metrics):
    bx = MARGIN + i * (col_w + box_gap)
    stat_box(draw, bx, grid_top, int(col_w), 180, num, lbl, clr, number_size=100)

# Bottom row: 3 boxes - center "43%" and "3.3–3.6 BILLION" as highlights
bottom_row_y = grid_top + 180 + box_gap
# Make them span differently: side boxes smaller, center larger
side_w = int(INNER_W * 0.27)
center_w = int(INNER_W * 0.40)
gap = (INNER_W - 2 * side_w - center_w) // 2

bottom_metrics = [
    ('~0.20 m', 'Sea level rise|(1901–2018)', VERMILION, side_w, False),
    ('43%',     'Required GHG reduction|by 2030 for 1.5°C pathway', DEEP_RED, center_w, True),
    ('3.3–3.6\nBILLION', 'Population exposed|to severe climate hazards', DEEP_RED, side_w, True),
]

bx_left = MARGIN
for i, (num, lbl, clr, bw, hl) in enumerate(bottom_metrics):
    stat_box(draw, bx_left, bottom_row_y, bw, 220, num, lbl, clr,
             number_size=110, highlight=hl)
    if i == 1:
        bx_left += center_w + gap
    else:
        bx_left += bw + gap

# Small warming stripe visual below metrics
stripe_y = bottom_row_y + 240
stripe_w = INNER_W
stripe_h = 14
stripe_x = MARGIN
# Warming stripes: blue → yellow → orange → red
stripe_colors = [
    (49, 110, 165), (72, 132, 168), (96, 154, 170), (119, 172, 168),
    (142, 186, 162), (164, 196, 152), (186, 203, 139), (207, 207, 125),
    (222, 195, 107), (232, 168, 56), (218, 140, 49), (204, 112, 42),
    (212, 68, 43), (190, 52, 38), (168, 36, 34), (139, 26, 26),
]
n_stripes = 80
sw = stripe_w / n_stripes
for i in range(n_stripes):
    t = i / (n_stripes - 1)
    cidx = min(int(t * (len(stripe_colors) - 1)), len(stripe_colors) - 1)
    draw_rect(draw, int(stripe_x + i * sw), stripe_y, math.ceil(sw), stripe_h,
              stripe_colors[cidx])

# Labels for stripes
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, stripe_y + stripe_h + 8), '1850', font_label_sm, MUTED)
draw_text(draw, (W - MARGIN - 60, stripe_y + stripe_h + 8), '2023', font_label_sm, MUTED)
draw_text(draw, ((MARGIN + W - MARGIN)//2 - 100, stripe_y + stripe_h + 8),
    'GLOBAL MEAN SURFACE TEMPERATURE ANOMALY  ·  WARMING STRIPES',
    font_label_sm, MUTED, anchor='lt')

y += metrics_h

# ── Divider ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_rect(draw, 0, y, W, 3, DIM)
y += 3

# ── SECTION 3: OBSERVED CHANGES & FUTURE PROJECTIONS ──────────────────
proj_h = 1200
draw_rect(draw, 0, y, W, proj_h, NAVY)

sec3_y = y
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, sec3_y + 40), 'OBSERVED CHANGES & FUTURE PROJECTIONS', font_label_sm, AMBER)
draw_hline(draw, sec3_y + 62, MARGIN, MARGIN + 400, AMBER, 1)

# --- Left panel: Observed Indicators ---
left_x = MARGIN
left_w = int(INNER_W * 0.42)
panel_top = sec3_y + 100

# Observed indicators as a clean data table
draw_text(draw, (left_x, panel_top), 'OBSERVED STATE', font_section, WHITE)

indicators = [
    ('Global surface temperature rise', '+1.1°C', '2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900'),
    ('Atmospheric CO₂ concentration', '410 ppm', '2019 — highest in ≥2M years'),
    ('Global GHG emissions', '~59 GtCO₂e', '2019'),
    ('Sea level rise', '~0.20 m', '1901–2018'),
    ('Arctic sea ice decline (Sept.)', '~40% area loss', '1979–2020'),
]

row_h = 52
table_top = panel_top + 60
col1_x = left_x
col2_x = left_x + int(left_w * 0.48)
col3_x = left_x + int(left_w * 0.75)

# Table header
draw_hline(draw, table_top, left_x, left_x + left_w, DIM, 1)
draw_text(draw, (col1_x, table_top + 10), 'Indicator', font_label_sm, MUTED)
draw_text(draw, (col2_x, table_top + 10), 'Value', font_label_sm, MUTED)
draw_text(draw, (col3_x, table_top + 10), 'Period', font_label_sm, MUTED)
draw_hline(draw, table_top + 30, left_x, left_x + left_w, DIM, 1)

for i, (ind, val, per) in enumerate(indicators):
    ry = table_top + 36 + i * row_h
    if i % 2 == 0:
        draw_rect(draw, left_x, ry - 4, left_w, row_h, (18, 32, 48))
    draw_text(draw, (col1_x, ry + 4), ind, font_body_sm, CREAM)
    draw_text(draw, (col2_x, ry + 4), val, load_font('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 26), AMBER)
    draw_text(draw, (col3_x, ry + 4), per, font_label_sm, MUTED)

draw_hline(draw, table_top + 36 + 5 * row_h, left_x, left_x + left_w, DIM, 1)

# Attribution note
attr_y = table_top + 36 + 5 * row_h + 20
draw_text(draw, (left_x, attr_y),
    'Every region experiences increasing frequency and intensity of extreme events',
    font_body_sm, CREAM)
draw_text(draw, (left_x, attr_y + 30),
    '— heatwaves, heavy precipitation, droughts, tropical cyclones — with clear human attribution.',
    font_body_sm, MUTED)

# --- Right panel: SSP Scenario Projections ---
right_x = left_x + left_w + 40
right_w = W - MARGIN - right_x

draw_text(draw, (right_x, panel_top), 'FUTURE TRAJECTORIES', font_section, WHITE)
draw_text(draw, (right_x, panel_top + 44), 'Projected warming by 2100 under Shared Socioeconomic Pathways',
    font_body_sm, MUTED)

# SSP scenario data
ssps = [
    ('SSP1-1.9', '~1.4°C', 'Very low emissions,\nsustainability focus', TEAL),
    ('SSP1-2.6', '~1.8°C', 'Low emissions', (100, 180, 150)),
    ('SSP2-4.5', '~2.7°C', 'Intermediate emissions', AMBER),
    ('SSP3-7.0', '~3.6°C', 'High emissions', (200, 100, 50)),
    ('SSP5-8.5', '~4.4°C', 'Very high emissions,\nfossil-fuel intensive', DEEP_RED),
]

# Draw SSP bands — diverging pathway visualization
band_top = panel_top + 100
band_h = 320
band_w = right_w - 20
band_x = right_x + 10

# Background for bands
draw_rect(draw, band_x, band_top, band_w, band_h, (14, 26, 48), radius=6)

# Draw diverging lines from a convergence point
conv_x = band_x + 30
conv_y_top = band_top + 60
conv_y_bottom = band_top + band_h - 40

# Draw curved diverging paths for each SSP
n_years = 100
path_w = band_w - 80
path_start_x = conv_x + 10

for idx, (name, temp, desc, color) in enumerate(ssps):
    # Vertical position based on warming level
    base_y = band_top + 30 + idx * (band_h // len(ssps)) + 25
    # Draw the scenario row
    row_x = conv_x + 10
    row_w = path_w

    # End temperature value
    end_x = band_x + band_w - 15

    # Draw a subtle line diverging
    start_y = conv_y_top + (idx - 2) * 25
    end_y = base_y

    # Draw connecting line with increasing thickness
    for pt in range(101):
        t = pt / 100.0
        px = int(row_x + t * row_w)
        # Curved path
        py = int(start_y + (end_y - start_y) * (t ** 1.5))
        alpha = int(140 + 100 * t)
        r, g, b = color
        c = (min(255, r), min(255, g), min(255, b))
        if pt % 3 == 0:
            draw.rectangle([px, py, px + 1, py + 1], fill=c)

    # Scenario name
    draw_text(draw, (row_x, base_y - 12), name, load_font('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 20), color)
    # Temperature value
    draw_text(draw, (end_x - 80, base_y - 12), temp, load_font('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 30), color)
    # Brief description
    draw_text(draw, (row_x, base_y + 14), desc, font_label_sm, MUTED)

# Sea level note
sl_y = band_top + band_h + 20
draw_text(draw, (right_x, sl_y),
    'Sea level rise by 2100: 0.28–0.55 m (SSP1-1.9) to 0.63–1.01 m (SSP5-8.5)',
    font_body_sm, CREAM)
draw_text(draw, (right_x, sl_y + 30),
    'Continued rise for centuries to millennia regardless of emissions pathway.',
    font_body_sm, MUTED)

y += proj_h

# ── Divider ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_rect(draw, 0, y, W, 3, VERMILION)
y += 3

# ── SECTION 4: RISKS & VULNERABILITIES ─────────────────────────────────
risks_h = 750
draw_rect(draw, 0, y, W, risks_h, SLATE)

sec4_y = y
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, sec4_y + 40), 'RISKS, VULNERABILITIES & CASCADING IMPACTS', font_label_sm, VERMILION)
draw_hline(draw, sec4_y + 62, MARGIN, MARGIN + 440, VERMILION, 1)

panel_top4 = sec4_y + 100

# Four risk columns
risk_cols = [
    ('EXPOSED\nPOPULATION', '3.3–3.6\nBILLION', 'People living in contexts\nhighly vulnerable to\nclimate change', AMBER),
    ('BIODIVERSITY\nLOSS', 'UP TO 14%', 'Terrestrial species facing\nvery high extinction risk\nat 1.5°C warming', VERMILION),
    ('FOOD & WATER\nSECURITY', 'HALF THE\nPOPULATION', 'Severe water scarcity\n≥1 month/year. Crop yields\nslowing globally.', DEEP_RED),
    ('HEALTH\nIMPACTS', 'EXPANDING', 'Heat-related mortality\nrising. Vector-borne\ndisease ranges growing.', VERMILION),
]

rcol_w = (INNER_W - 3 * 20) // 4
rcol_x = MARGIN
risk_box_h = 340

for i, (title, value, desc, clr) in enumerate(risk_cols):
    rx = rcol_x + i * (rcol_w + 20)
    # Card
    draw_rect(draw, rx, panel_top4, rcol_w, risk_box_h, DARK_SLATE, radius=6)
    # Top accent line
    draw_rect(draw, rx, panel_top4, rcol_w, 4, clr, radius=2)
    # Title
    draw_text(draw, (rx + 24, panel_top4 + 24), title, load_font('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 22), WHITE)
    # Value
    draw_text(draw, (rx + 24, panel_top4 + 100), value,
        load_font('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 48), clr)
    # Description
    draw_text(draw, (rx + 24, panel_top4 + 210), desc, font_body_sm, CREAM)

# Cascading risk description
casc_y = panel_top4 + risk_box_h + 30
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, casc_y),
    'CASCADING & COMPOUNDING RISKS',
    font_section, WHITE)
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, casc_y + 48),
    'Climate hazards increasingly interact with poverty, inequality, and ecosystem degradation to produce cascading and compounding impacts.',
    font_body, CREAM)
draw_text(draw, (MARGIN, casc_y + 88),
    'Risks are magnified across interconnected systems — food, water, health, infrastructure, and biodiversity.',
    font_body_sm, MUTED)

y += risks_h

# ── Divider ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_rect(draw, 0, y, W, 3, DIM)
y += 3

# ── SECTION 5: MITIGATION & NARROWING WINDOW ──────────────────────────
mit_h = 950

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings Poster
A0 Portrait, 3508×4961 px at 150 DPI
Design Philosophy: Empirical Sublime
Second Pass — Museum-Quality Refinement
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import math

# ── Canvas Setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4961  # A0 portrait at 150 DPI
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 36
INNER_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), '#0B1D3A')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE      = (30, 45, 64)
DARK_CARD  = (22, 35, 52)
DEEP_BG    = (16, 36, 62)
CREAM      = (228, 222, 210)
WHITE      = (248, 246, 242)
AMBER      = (232, 168, 56)
AMBER_DIM  = (190, 138, 44)
VERMILION  = (212, 68, 43)
VERM_DIM   = (180, 52, 32)
DEEP_RED   = (139, 26, 26)
TEAL       = (45, 139, 139)
TEAL_DIM   = (38, 118, 118)
MUTED      = (105, 118, 132)
DIM        = (60, 72, 88)
FAINT      = (38, 48, 62)

# ── Font System ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = '/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts'

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

# Headline & display
f_title     = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 196)
f_mega_num  = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 210)
f_large_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 126)
f_med_num   = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 90)
f_small_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 56)

# Section headings
f_section   = F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 48)
f_subsec    = F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 32)

# Body
f_body      = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 28)
f_body_sm   = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 22)
f_body_xs   = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 18)

# Labels
f_label     = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 20)
f_label_sm  = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 16)
f_caption   = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 14)

# ── Drawing Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def txt(xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    x, y = xy
    if '\n' in text:
        draw.multiline_text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def txt_c(range_tuple, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text horizontally within (x0, x1)."""
    x0, x1 = range_tuple
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2 - tw / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def txt_r(x, y, text, font, fill):
    """Right-align text at x."""
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x - tw, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):
    if radius:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=radius, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], fill=fill)

def frame(x, y, w, h, color, width=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], outline=color, width=width)

def hline(y, x0, x1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y + w], fill=color)

def vline(x, y0, y1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y0, x + w, y1], fill=color)

def accent_bar(x, y, w, color):
    """A thin accent bar — 4px tall."""
    rect(x, y, w, 4, color)

# ── Warming Stripe Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_warming_stripes(x, y, w, h, n=120):
    """Draw a warming stripes bar — blue to red gradient."""
    colors = [
        (49, 110, 165), (58, 120, 168), (68, 130, 170), (78, 140, 170),
        (88, 150, 168), (98, 158, 165), (108, 166, 162), (118, 173, 158),
        (128, 179, 153), (139, 184, 148), (150, 188, 142), (161, 190, 136),
        (172, 191, 130), (182, 191, 122), (192, 190, 114), (200, 187, 106),
        (208, 183, 98), (216, 178, 90), (222, 171, 81), (228, 163, 72),
        (232, 153, 63), (230, 143, 55), (226, 132, 48), (220, 121, 42),
        (212, 68, 43), (200, 56, 38), (185, 46, 34), (170, 36, 30),
        (155, 28, 26), (139, 26, 26),
    ]
    n_colors = len(colors)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / (n - 1)
        ci = min(int(t * (n_colors - 1)), n_colors - 1)
        px = int(x + i * w / n)
        pw = int((x + (i + 1) * w / n) - px)
        rect(px, y, pw, h, colors[ci])

# ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DEEP_BG    = (16, 36, 62)

# Headline & display

f_large_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 126)

f_small_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 56)

f_subsec    = F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 32)

f_body_xs   = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 18)

f_caption   = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 14)

# ── Drawing Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def txt(xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    x, y = xy
    if '\n' in text:
        draw.multiline_text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def txt_c(range_tuple, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text horizontally within (x0, x1)."""
    x0, x1 = range_tuple
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2 - tw / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def txt_r(x, y, text, font, fill):
    """Right-align text at x."""
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x - tw, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):

    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], outline=color, width=width)

def hline(y, x0, x1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y + w], fill=color)

def vline(x, y0, y1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y0, x + w, y1], fill=color)

def accent_bar(x, y, w, color):
    """A thin accent bar — 4px tall."""
    rect(x, y, w, 4, color)

# ── Warming Stripe Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_warming_stripes(x, y, w, h, n=120):
    """Draw a warming stripes bar — blue to red gradient."""
    colors = [
        (49, 110, 165), (58, 120, 168), (68, 130, 170), (78, 140, 170),
        (88, 150, 168), (98, 158, 165), (108, 166, 162), (118, 173, 158),
        (128, 179, 153), (139, 184, 148), (150, 188, 142), (161, 190, 136),
        (172, 191, 130), (182, 191, 122), (192, 190, 114), (200, 187, 106),
        (208, 183, 98), (216, 178, 90), (222, 171, 81), (228, 163, 72),
        (232, 153, 63), (230, 143, 55), (226, 132, 48), (220, 121, 42),
        (212, 68, 43), (200, 56, 38), (185, 46, 34), (170, 36, 30),
        (155, 28, 26), (139, 26, 26),
    ]
    n_colors = len(colors)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / (n - 1)
        ci = min(int(t * (n_colors - 1)), n_colors - 1)
        px = int(x + i * w / n)
        pw = int((x + (i + 1) * w / n) - px)
        rect(px, y, pw, h, colors[ci])

# ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def stat_card(x, y, w, h, number, label, accent_color, emphasis=False):
    """A single metric callout card."""
    bg = tuple(max(0, c + 8) for c in DARK_CARD)
    rect(x, y, w, h, bg, radius=8)

    if emphasis:
        # Accent bar on top
        accent_bar(x, y, w, accent_color)
        # Subtle glow band
        rect(x, y + 4, w, 2, tuple(min(255, c + 40) for c in accent_color))

    pad = 32
    num_size = f_large_num if emphasis else f_med_num
    txt((x + pad, y + 18 if emphasis else y + 14), number, num_size, accent_color)

    lines = label.split('|')
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        ly = y + h - 22 * (len(lines) - i) - 14
        txt((x + pad, ly), line, f_label_sm, MUTED)

# ── Section Label ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(x, y, text, accent):
    txt((x, y), text.upper(), f_label, accent)
    hline(y + 20, x, x + 360, accent, 1)

# ── Drawing Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def txt(xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    x, y = xy
    if '\n' in text:
        draw.multiline_text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def txt_c(range_tuple, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text horizontally within (x0, x1)."""
    x0, x1 = range_tuple
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2 - tw / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def txt_r(x, y, text, font, fill):
    """Right-align text at x."""
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x - tw, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):
    if radius:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=radius, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], fill=fill)

def frame(x, y, w, h, color, width=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], outline=color, width=width)

def hline(y, x0, x1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y + w], fill=color)

def vline(x, y0, y1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y0, x + w, y1], fill=color)

def accent_bar(x, y, w, color):
    """A thin accent bar — 4px tall."""
    rect(x, y, w, 4, color)

# ── Warming Stripe Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_warming_stripes(x, y, w, h, n=120):
    """Draw a warming stripes bar — blue to red gradient."""
    colors = [
        (49, 110, 165), (58, 120, 168), (68, 130, 170), (78, 140, 170),
        (88, 150, 168), (98, 158, 165), (108, 166, 162), (118, 173, 158),
        (128, 179, 153), (139, 184, 148), (150, 188, 142), (161, 190, 136),
        (172, 191, 130), (182, 191, 122), (192, 190, 114), (200, 187, 106),
        (208, 183, 98), (216, 178, 90), (222, 171, 81), (228, 163, 72),
        (232, 153, 63), (230, 143, 55), (226, 132, 48), (220, 121, 42),
        (212, 68, 43), (200, 56, 38), (185, 46, 34), (170, 36, 30),
        (155, 28, 26), (139, 26, 26),
    ]
    n_colors = len(colors)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / (n - 1)
        ci = min(int(t * (n_colors - 1)), n_colors - 1)
        px = int(x + i * w / n)
        pw = int((x + (i + 1) * w / n) - px)
        rect(px, y, pw, h, colors[ci])

# ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def stat_card(x, y, w, h, number, label, accent_color, emphasis=False):
    """A single metric callout card."""
    bg = tuple(max(0, c + 8) for c in DARK_CARD)
    rect(x, y, w, h, bg, radius=8)

    if emphasis:
        # Accent bar on top
        accent_bar(x, y, w, accent_color)
        # Subtle glow band
        rect(x, y + 4, w, 2, tuple(min(255, c + 40) for c in accent_color))

    pad = 32
    num_size = f_large_num if emphasis else f_med_num
    txt((x + pad, y + 18 if emphasis else y + 14), number, num_size, accent_color)

    lines = label.split('|')
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        ly = y + h - 22 * (len(lines) - i) - 14
        txt((x + pad, ly), line, f_label_sm, MUTED)

# ── Section Label ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(x, y, text, accent):
    txt((x, y), text.upper(), f_label, accent)
    hline(y + 20, x, x + 360, accent, 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings Poster
A0 Portrait, 3508×4961 px at 150 DPI
Design Philosophy: Empirical Sublime
Second Pass — Museum-Quality Refinement
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import math

# ── Canvas Setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4961  # A0 portrait at 150 DPI
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 36
INNER_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), '#0B1D3A')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE      = (30, 45, 64)
DARK_CARD  = (22, 35, 52)
DEEP_BG    = (16, 36, 62)
CREAM      = (228, 222, 210)
WHITE      = (248, 246, 242)
AMBER      = (232, 168, 56)
AMBER_DIM  = (190, 138, 44)
VERMILION  = (212, 68, 43)
VERM_DIM   = (180, 52, 32)
DEEP_RED   = (139, 26, 26)
TEAL       = (45, 139, 139)
TEAL_DIM   = (38, 118, 118)
MUTED      = (105, 118, 132)
DIM        = (60, 72, 88)
FAINT      = (38, 48, 62)

# ── Font System ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = '/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts'

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

# Headline & display
f_title     = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 196)
f_mega_num  = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 210)
f_large_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 126)
f_med_num   = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 90)
f_small_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 56)

# Section headings
f_section   = F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 48)
f_subsec    = F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 32)

# Body
f_body      = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 28)
f_body_sm   = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 22)
f_body_xs   = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 18)

# Labels
f_label     = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 20)
f_label_sm  = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 16)
f_caption   = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 14)

# ── Drawing Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def txt(xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    x, y = xy
    if '\n' in text:
        draw.multiline_text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def txt_c(range_tuple, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text horizontally within (x0, x1)."""
    x0, x1 = range_tuple
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2 - tw / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def txt_r(x, y, text, font, fill):
    """Right-align text at x."""
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x - tw, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):
    if radius:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=radius, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], fill=fill)

def frame(x, y, w, h, color, width=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], outline=color, width=width)

def hline(y, x0, x1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y + w], fill=color)

def vline(x, y0, y1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y0, x + w, y1], fill=color)

def accent_bar(x, y, w, color):
    """A thin accent bar — 4px tall."""
    rect(x, y, w, 4, color)

# ── Warming Stripe Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_warming_stripes(x, y, w, h, n=120):
    """Draw a warming stripes bar — blue to red gradient."""
    colors = [
        (49, 110, 165), (58, 120, 168), (68, 130, 170), (78, 140, 170),
        (88, 150, 168), (98, 158, 165), (108, 166, 162), (118, 173, 158),
        (128, 179, 153), (139, 184, 148), (150, 188, 142), (161, 190, 136),
        (172, 191, 130), (182, 191, 122), (192, 190, 114), (200, 187, 106),
        (208, 183, 98), (216, 178, 90), (222, 171, 81), (228, 163, 72),
        (232, 153, 63), (230, 143, 55), (226, 132, 48), (220, 121, 42),
        (212, 68, 43), (200, 56, 38), (185, 46, 34), (170, 36, 30),
        (155, 28, 26), (139, 26, 26),
    ]
    n_colors = len(colors)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / (n - 1)
        ci = min(int(t * (n_colors - 1)), n_colors - 1)
        px = int(x + i * w / n)
        pw = int((x + (i + 1) * w / n) - px)
        rect(px, y, pw, h, colors[ci])

# ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def stat_card(x, y, w, h, number, label, accent_color, emphasis=False):
    """A single metric callout card."""
    bg = tuple(max(0, c + 8) for c in DARK_CARD)
    rect(x, y, w, h, bg, radius=8)

    if emphasis:
        # Accent bar on top
        accent_bar(x, y, w, accent_color)
        # Subtle glow band
        rect(x, y + 4, w, 2, tuple(min(255, c + 40) for c in accent_color))

    pad = 32
    num_size = f_large_num if emphasis else f_med_num
    txt((x + pad, y + 18 if emphasis else y + 14), number, num_size, accent_color)

    lines = label.split('|')
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        ly = y + h - 22 * (len(lines) - i) - 14
        txt((x + pad, ly), line, f_label_sm, MUTED)

# ── Section Label ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(x, y, text, accent):
    txt((x, y), text.upper(), f_label, accent)
    hline(y + 20, x, x + 360, accent, 1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CANVAS COMPOSITION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Top institutional strip ────────────────────────────────────────────
rect(0, 0, W, 8, AMBER)
rect(0, 8, W, 3, VERMILION)

# IPCC wordmark
txt((MARGIN, 36), 'INTERGOVERNMENTAL PANEL ON CLIMATE CHANGE', f_caption, MUTED)
txt((MARGIN, 54), 'AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT  ·  CLIMATE CHANGE 2023', f_caption, DIM)

# ── SECTION 1: TITLE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
cur_y = 138

txt((MARGIN, cur_y), 'CLIMATE CHANGE', f_title, WHITE)
cur_y += 160
txt((MARGIN, cur_y), '2023', f_title, AMBER)
cur_y += 150

# Subtitle
txt((MARGIN, cur_y),
    'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
    f_body, CREAM)
cur_y += 48

# Venue / divider
hline(cur_y, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, DIM, 1)
cur_y += 20
txt((MARGIN, cur_y),
    'CLIMATE SCIENCE CONFERENCE  ·  IPCC AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT DISSEMINATION',
    f_caption, MUTED)
cur_y += 56

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  SECTION 2: SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s2_bg_y = cur_y
s2_h = 1080

# Background band
rect(0, s2_bg_y, W, s2_h, SLATE)
# Subtle inner border
frame(MARGIN - 12, s2_bg_y + 12, INNER_W + 24, s2_h - 24, FAINT, 1)

s2_inner = s2_bg_y + 40
section_label(MARGIN, s2_inner, 'ASSESSED METRICS AT A GLANCE', AMBER)

grid_top = s2_inner + 44

# ── Top row: 4 stat cards ──────────────────────────────────────────────
n_top = 4
top_card_w = (INNER_W - 3 * COL_GAP) // n_top
top_card_h = 200

top_metrics = [
    ('1.1°C',  'Global surface temperature|increase 2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900', VERMILION),
    ('410 ppm','Atmospheric CO₂ concentration|in 2019 — highest in 2 million years', AMBER),
    ('~59',    'Total global GHG emissions|in 2019 (GtCO₂-equivalent)', AMBER),
    ('~500',   'Remaining carbon budget for|1.5°C, 50% likelihood, from 2020', TEAL),
]

for i, (num, lbl, clr) in enumerate(top_metrics):
    cx = MARGIN + i * (top_card_w + COL_GAP)
    stat_card(cx, grid_top, top_card_w, top_card_h, num, lbl, clr)

# ── Bottom row: 3 stat cards, emphasis on center ───────────────────────
bot_row_y = grid_top + top_card_h + 28

# Layout: side(28%) - gap - center(38%) - gap - side(28%)
side_w = int(INNER_W * 0.27)
center_w = INNER_W - 2 * side_w - 2 * COL_GAP
bot_card_h = 240

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings Poster
A0 Portrait, 3508×4961 px at 150 DPI
Design Philosophy: Empirical Sublime
Second Pass — Museum-Quality Refinement
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import math

# ── Canvas Setup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4961  # A0 portrait at 150 DPI
MARGIN = 200
COL_GAP = 36
INNER_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), '#0B1D3A')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE      = (30, 45, 64)
DARK_CARD  = (22, 35, 52)
DEEP_BG    = (16, 36, 62)
CREAM      = (228, 222, 210)
WHITE      = (248, 246, 242)
AMBER      = (232, 168, 56)
AMBER_DIM  = (190, 138, 44)
VERMILION  = (212, 68, 43)
VERM_DIM   = (180, 52, 32)
DEEP_RED   = (139, 26, 26)
TEAL       = (45, 139, 139)
TEAL_DIM   = (38, 118, 118)
MUTED      = (105, 118, 132)
DIM        = (60, 72, 88)
FAINT      = (38, 48, 62)

# ── Font System ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = '/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts'

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

# Headline & display
f_title     = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 196)
f_mega_num  = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 210)
f_large_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 126)
f_med_num   = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 90)
f_small_num = F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 56)

# Section headings
f_section   = F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 48)
f_subsec    = F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 32)

# Body
f_body      = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 28)
f_body_sm   = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 22)
f_body_xs   = F('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 18)

# Labels
f_label     = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 20)
f_label_sm  = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 16)
f_caption   = F('Jura-Light.ttf', 14)

# ── Drawing Utilities ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def txt(xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    x, y = xy
    if '\n' in text:
        draw.multiline_text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def txt_c(range_tuple, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text horizontally within (x0, x1)."""
    x0, x1 = range_tuple
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2 - tw / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def txt_r(x, y, text, font, fill):
    """Right-align text at x."""
    bbox = font.getbbox(text)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((x - tw, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):
    if radius:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=radius, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], fill=fill)

def frame(x, y, w, h, color, width=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + h], outline=color, width=width)

def hline(y, x0, x1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y + w], fill=color)

def vline(x, y0, y1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y0, x + w, y1], fill=color)

def accent_bar(x, y, w, color):
    """A thin accent bar — 4px tall."""
    rect(x, y, w, 4, color)

# ── Warming Stripe Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_warming_stripes(x, y, w, h, n=120):
    """Draw a warming stripes bar — blue to red gradient."""
    colors = [
        (49, 110, 165), (58, 120, 168), (68, 130, 170), (78, 140, 170),
        (88, 150, 168), (98, 158, 165), (108, 166, 162), (118, 173, 158),
        (128, 179, 153), (139, 184, 148), (150, 188, 142), (161, 190, 136),
        (172, 191, 130), (182, 191, 122), (192, 190, 114), (200, 187, 106),
        (208, 183, 98), (216, 178, 90), (222, 171, 81), (228, 163, 72),
        (232, 153, 63), (230, 143, 55), (226, 132, 48), (220, 121, 42),
        (212, 68, 43), (200, 56, 38), (185, 46, 34), (170, 36, 30),
        (155, 28, 26), (139, 26, 26),
    ]
    n_colors = len(colors)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / (n - 1)
        ci = min(int(t * (n_colors - 1)), n_colors - 1)
        px = int(x + i * w / n)
        pw = int((x + (i + 1) * w / n) - px)
        rect(px, y, pw, h, colors[ci])

# ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def stat_card(x, y, w, h, number, label, accent_color, emphasis=False):
    """A single metric callout card."""
    bg = tuple(max(0, c + 8) for c in DARK_CARD)
    rect(x, y, w, h, bg, radius=8)

    if emphasis:
        # Accent bar on top
        accent_bar(x, y, w, accent_color)
        # Subtle glow band
        rect(x, y + 4, w, 2, tuple(min(255, c + 40) for c in accent_color))

    pad = 32
    num_size = f_large_num if emphasis else f_med_num
    txt((x + pad, y + 18 if emphasis else y + 14), number, num_size, accent_color)

    lines = label.split('|')
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        ly = y + h - 22 * (len(lines) - i) - 14
        txt((x + pad, ly), line, f_label_sm, MUTED)

# ── Section Label ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def section_label(x, y, text, accent):
    txt((x, y), text.upper(), f_label, accent)
    hline(y + 20, x, x + 360, accent, 1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CANVAS COMPOSITION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Top institutional strip ────────────────────────────────────────────
rect(0, 0, W, 8, AMBER)
rect(0, 8, W, 3, VERMILION)

# IPCC wordmark
txt((MARGIN, 36), 'INTERGOVERNMENTAL PANEL ON CLIMATE CHANGE', f_caption, MUTED)
txt((MARGIN, 54), 'AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT  ·  CLIMATE CHANGE 2023', f_caption, DIM)

# ── SECTION 1: TITLE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
cur_y = 138

txt((MARGIN, cur_y), 'CLIMATE CHANGE', f_title, WHITE)
cur_y += 160
txt((MARGIN, cur_y), '2023', f_title, AMBER)
cur_y += 150

# Subtitle
txt((MARGIN, cur_y),
    'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report',
    f_body, CREAM)
cur_y += 48

# Venue / divider
hline(cur_y, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, DIM, 1)
cur_y += 20
txt((MARGIN, cur_y),
    'CLIMATE SCIENCE CONFERENCE  ·  IPCC AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT DISSEMINATION',
    f_caption, MUTED)
cur_y += 56

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  SECTION 2: SEVEN HEADLINE METRICS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s2_bg_y = cur_y
s2_h = 1080

# Background band
rect(0, s2_bg_y, W, s2_h, SLATE)
# Subtle inner border
frame(MARGIN - 12, s2_bg_y + 12, INNER_W + 24, s2_h - 24, FAINT, 1)

s2_inner = s2_bg_y + 40
section_label(MARGIN, s2_inner, 'ASSESSED METRICS AT A GLANCE', AMBER)

grid_top = s2_inner + 44

# ── Top row: 4 stat cards ──────────────────────────────────────────────
n_top = 4
top_card_w = (INNER_W - 3 * COL_GAP) // n_top
top_card_h = 200

top_metrics = [
    ('1.1°C',  'Global surface temperature|increase 2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900', VERMILION),
    ('410 ppm','Atmospheric CO₂ concentration|in 2019 — highest in 2 million years', AMBER),
    ('~59',    'Total global GHG emissions|in 2019 (GtCO₂-equivalent)', AMBER),
    ('~500',   'Remaining carbon budget for|1.5°C, 50% likelihood, from 2020', TEAL),
]

for i, (num, lbl, clr) in enumerate(top_metrics):
    cx = MARGIN + i * (top_card_w + COL_GAP)
    stat_card(cx, grid_top, top_card_w, top_card_h, num, lbl, clr)

# ── Bottom row: 3 stat cards, emphasis on center ───────────────────────
bot_row_y = grid_top + top_card_h + 28

# Layout: side(28%) - gap - center(38%) - gap - side(28%)
side_w = int(INNER_W * 0.27)
center_w = INNER_W - 2 * side_w - 2 * COL_GAP
bot_card_h = 240

bot_metrics = [
    ('~0.20 m', 'Sea level rise|1901–2018', VERMILION, side_w, False),
    ('43%',     'Required GHG reduction by|2030 for 1.5°C pathway', DEEP_RED, center_w, True),
    ('3.3–3.6', 'BILLION PEOPLE|exposed to severe climate hazards', DEEP_RED, side_w, True),
]

bx = MARGIN
for num, lbl, clr, cw, emph in bot_metrics:
    stat_card(bx, bot_row_y, cw, bot_card_h, num, lbl, clr, emphasis=emph)
    bx += cw + COL_GAP

# ── Warming stripes integration ────────────────────────────────────────
stripe_y = bot_row_y + bot_card_h + 36
stripe_h = 16
stripe_w = INNER_W

# Label
txt((MARGIN, stripe_y - 24), 'GLOBAL MEAN SURFACE TEMPERATURE ANOMALY', f_label_sm, MUTED)
txt_r(W - MARGIN, stripe_y - 24, '1850–2023  ·  WARMING STRIPES (ED HAWKINS)', f_caption, DIM)

draw_warming_stripes(MARGIN, stripe_y, stripe_w, stripe_h, n=160)
frame(MARGIN - 1, stripe_y - 1, stripe_w + 2, stripe_h + 2, DIM, 1)

# End labels
txt((MARGIN, stripe_y + stripe_h + 6), '1850', f_caption, DIM)
txt_r(W - MARGIN, stripe_y + stripe_h + 6), '2023', f_caption, DIM)

cur_y = s2_bg_y + s2_h

# ── Section divider ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
hline(cur_y, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, DIM, 1)
cur_y += 1

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  SECTION 3: OBSERVED CHANGES & FUTURE PROJECTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
s3_y = cur_y
s3_h = 1180

rect(0, s3_y, W, s3_h, NAVY)
section_label(MARGIN, s3_y + 38, 'OBSERVED CHANGES & FUTURE PROJECTIONS', AMBER)

col_left_w = int(INNER_W * 0.44)
col_right_w = INNER_W - col_left_w - COL_GAP * 2
panel_top = s3_y + 90

# --- LEFT: Observed Indicators Table ---
txt((MARGIN, panel_top), 'OBSERVED STATE', f_section, WHITE)

indicators = [
    ('Surface temperature rise', '+1.1°C', '2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900'),
    ('Atmospheric CO₂', '410 ppm', '2019; highest in ≥2 million years'),
    ('Global GHG emissions', '~59 GtCO₂e', '2019 total'),
    ('Sea level rise', '~0.20 m', '1901–2018 cumulative'),
    ('Arctic sea ice decline', '~40% area loss', '1979–2020 (September)'),
]

tbl_y = panel_top + 56
row_h = 48
c1_x = MARGIN
c2_x = MARGIN + int(col_left_w * 0.44)
c3_x = MARGIN + int(col_left_w * 0.72)

# Header row
rect(MARGIN, tbl_y, col_left_w, 32, (18, 32, 48))
txt((c1_x + 14, tbl_y + 6), 'INDICATOR', f_label_sm, MUTED)
txt((c2_x, tbl_y + 6), 'VALUE', f_label_sm, MUTED)
txt((c3_x, tbl_y + 6), 'REFERENCE PERIOD', f_label_sm, MUTED)

for i, (ind, val, ref) in enumerate(indicators):
    ry = tbl_y + 36 + i * row_h
    if i % 2 == 0:
        rect(MARGIN, ry - 2, col_left_w, row_h, (14, 26, 46))
    txt((c1_x + 14, ry + 8), ind, f_body_sm, CREAM)
    txt((c2_x, ry + 8), val, F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 24), AMBER)
    txt((c3_x, ry + 8), ref, f_label_sm, MUTED)

# Bottom rule
hline(tbl_y + 36 + 5 * row_h + 2, MARGIN, MARGIN + col_left_w, FAINT, 1)

# Attribution text
attr_y = tbl_y + 36 + 5 * row_h + 28
txt((MARGIN, attr_y),
    'Every inhabited region now experiences increases in the frequency and intensity',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
txt((MARGIN, attr_y + 26),
    'of extreme weather — heatwaves, heavy precipitation, droughts, tropical cyclones —',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
txt((MARGIN, attr_y + 52),
    'all with clear attribution to human influence on the climate system.',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

# --- RIGHT: SSP Scenario Projections ---
rx = MARGIN + col_left_w + COL_GAP * 2
txt((rx, panel_top), 'FUTURE TRAJECTORIES', f_section, WHITE)
txt((rx, panel_top + 42),
    'Projected global warming by 2100 under Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs)',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

sp_y = panel_top + 90
ssps = [
    ('SSP1-1.9', '~1.4°C', 'Very low emissions · sustainability focus', TEAL),
    ('SSP1-2.6', '~1.8°C', 'Low emissions pathway', (92, 170, 142)),
    ('SSP2-4.5', '~2.7°C', 'Intermediate emissions pathway', AMBER),
    ('SSP3-7.0', '~3.6°C', 'High emissions pathway', (208, 108, 52)),
    ('SSP5-8.5', '~4.4°C', 'Very high · fossil-fuel intensive', DEEP_RED),
]

# Background for SSP strip
rect(rx, sp_y, col_right_w, len(ssps) * 68 + 36, DARK_CARD, radius=8)

# Diverging temperature visualization
div_x = rx + 40
div_w = col_right_w - 80

for idx, (name, temp, desc, clr) in enumerate(ssps):
    row_y = sp_y + 20 + idx * 68

    # Scenario dot + line
    # Horizontal bar showing warming magnitude
    bar_y = row_y + 30
    bar_h = 8
    bar_max_w = div_w - 140

    # Scale: 1.4°C → ~31px, 4.4°C → ~100px (full bar)
    temp_val = float(temp.replace('~', '').replace('°C', ''))
    bar_frac = (temp_val - 0.8) / 4.0
    bar_w = int(20 + bar_frac * (bar_max_w - 20))

    # Fading trail
    trail_w = int(bar_w * 0.25)
    for ti in range(trail_w):
        alpha = 0.15 + 0.85 * (ti / trail_w)
        r, g, b = clr
        fade = tuple(max(0, min(255, int(c * alpha))) for c in (r, g, b))
        rect(div_x + ti, bar_y, 1, bar_h, fade)

    # Main bar
    rect(div_x + trail_w, bar_y, bar_w - trail_w, bar_h, clr)
    # End indicator
    rect(div_x + bar_w - 3, bar_y - 3, 6, bar_h + 6, clr)

    # Text
    txt((div_x, row_y - 4), name, F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 22), clr)
    txt((div_x + bar_w + 16, row_y - 4), temp, F('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 28), clr)
    txt((div_x, row_y + 42), desc, f_label_sm, MUTED)

# Sea level projection note
sl_note_y = sp_y + len(ssps) * 68 + 44
txt((rx, sl_note_y),
    'Sea level rise by 2100: 0.28–0.55 m (SSP1-1.9)  ·  0.63–1.01 m (SSP5-8.5)',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
txt((rx, sl_note_y + 28),
    'Continued rise for centuries to millennia regardless of emissions pathway.',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

cur_y = s3_y + s3_h

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  SECTION 4: RISKS, VULNERABILITIES & CASCADING IMPACTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
hline(cur_y, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, VERM_DIM, 1)
cur_y += 1

s4_y = cur_y
s4_h = 720

rect(0, s4_y, W, s4_h, SLATE)
section_label(MARGIN, s4_y + 38, 'RISKS, VULNERABILITIES & CASCADING IMPACTS', VERMILION)

p4_top = s4_y + 90

# Four risk columns
risk_data = [
    ('EXPOSED\nPOPULATION', '3.3–3.6', 'BILLION', 'People in contexts|highly vulnerable to|climate change impacts', AMBER),
    ('BIODIVERSITY\nLOSS', 'UP TO 14%', '', 'Terrestrial species at|very high extinction|risk at 1.5°C warming', VERMILION),
    ('FOOD & WATER\nSECURITY', 'HALF OF', 'POPULATION', 'Experiences severe water|scarcity ≥1 month/year.|Crop yields slowing.', DEEP_RED),
    ('HEALTH\nIMPACTS', 'EXPANDING', '', 'Heat-related mortality|rising. Vector-borne|disease ranges growing.', VERMILION),
]

rcol_w = (INNER_W - 3 * COL_GAP) // 4
rcol_h = 320

for i, (title, val, sub, desc, clr) in enumerate(risk_data):
    rx = MARGIN + i * (rcol_w + COL_GAP)

    # Card
    rect(rx, p4_top, rcol_w, rcol_h, DARK_CARD, radius=8)
    # Accent top
    accent_bar(rx, p4_top, rcol_w, clr)

    pad = 24
    # Title
    txt((rx + pad, p4_top + 24), title, F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 20), WHITE)

    # Value line
    val_y = p4_top + 100
    vfont = f_med_num

    bbox = vfont.getbbox(val)
    vw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    txt((rx + pad, val_y), val, vfont, clr)

    if sub:
        txt((rx + pad, val_y + 64), sub, F('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 18), clr)

    # Description
    desc_y = p4_top + 200

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings
A0 Portrait 3508×4961 px at 150 DPI
Design Philosophy: Empirical Sublime
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

W, H = 3508, 4961
M  = 200  # master margin
IW = W - 2 * M
G  = 32   # column gap

canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), '#0B1D3A')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY      = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE     = (30, 45, 64)
CARD_BG   = (21, 34, 50)
CARD_ALT  = (18, 30, 46)
CREAM     = (228, 222, 210)
WHITE     = (248, 246, 242)
AMBER     = (232, 168, 56)
AMBER_DIM = (195, 142, 44)
VERMILION = (212, 68, 43)
VERM_DIM  = (185, 56, 34)
DEEP_RED  = (139, 26, 26)
TEAL      = (45, 139, 139)
TEAL_DIM  = (38, 118, 118)
MUTED     = (105, 118, 132)
DIM       = (62, 74, 90)
FAINT     = (38, 48, 64)
RULE      = (48, 58, 76)

# ── Font System ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = '/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts'
def load(name, sz): return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), sz)

# Display hierarchy
f_title      = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 196)
f_mega       = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 210)
f_large_num  = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 126)
f_med_num    = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 84)
f_small_num  = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 54)
f_section    = load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 48)
f_subsec     = load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 32)
f_subsec_sm  = load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 24)
f_body       = load('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 28)
f_body_sm    = load('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 22)
f_body_xs    = load('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 18)
f_label      = load('Jura-Light.ttf', 20)
f_label_sm   = load('Jura-Light.ttf', 16)
f_caption    = load('Jura-Light.ttf', 14)

# ── Drawing Primitives ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _txt(xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    x, y = xy
    if '\n' in text:
        draw.multiline_text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def tcenter(xr, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text in horizontal range (x0, x1)."""
    b = font.getbbox(text)
    cx = (xr[0] + xr[1]) / 2 - (b[2] - b[0]) / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def tright(x, y, text, font, fill):
    b = font.getbbox(text)
    draw.text((x - (b[2] - b[0]), y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):
    if radius:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=radius, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], fill=fill)

def hrule(y, x0, x1, color, h=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y+h], fill=color)

def vrule(x, y0, y1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y0, x+w, y1], fill=color)

def accent(x, y, w, color, h=4):
    rect(x, y, w, h, color)

def dot(x, y, color, r=3):
    rect(x-r, y-r, r*2, r*2, color)

def sidemark(x, y, color):
    """Small right-side registration mark."""
    rect(x, y, 12, 1, color)

# ── Warming Stripes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def warming_stripes(x, y, w, h, n=160):
    palette = [
        (49,110,165),(58,120,168),(67,130,171),(77,140,171),(87,149,169),
        (97,157,166),(108,164,163),(118,171,159),(129,177,155),(140,182,150),
        (151,186,144),(162,189,138),(173,190,132),(183,191,124),(193,190,116),
        (202,188,108),(210,185,100),(218,180,92),(224,174,83),(230,167,73),
        (232,158,64),(231,148,56),(228,138,49),(223,128,43),(212,68,43),
        (203,58,38),(192,48,34),(181,38,30),(170,30,27),(139,26,26),
    ]
    npal = len(palette)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / (n - 1)
        ci = min(int(t * (npal - 1)), npal - 1)
        px = int(x + i * w / n)
        pw = max(1, int((x + (i + 1) * w / n) - px))
        rect(px, y, pw, h, palette[ci])

# ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def stat_card(x, y, w, h, number, label, accent_color, emph=False):
    bg = tuple(max(0, c+10) for c in CARD_BG)
    rect(x, y, w, h, bg, radius=8)
    if emph:
        accent(x, y, w, accent_color, 4)
        rect(x, y+4, w, 3, tuple(min(255, c+60) for c in accent_color))
    pad = 30
    nf = f_large_num if emph else f_med_num
    _txt((x+pad, y+16 if emph else y+12), number, nf, accent_color)
    for i, line in enumerate(label.split('|')):
        _txt((x+pad, y+h-22*(len(label.split('|'))-i)-14), line, f_label_sm, MUTED)

def section_head(x, y, text, accent):
    _txt((x, y), text.upper(), f_label, accent)
    hrule(y+22, x, x+380, accent, 1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  COMPOSITION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Header band —
rect(0, 0, W, 8, AMBER)
rect(0, 8, W, 3, VERMILION)
_txt((M, 36), 'INTERGOVERNMENTAL PANEL ON CLIMATE CHANGE', f_caption, MUTED)
_txt((M, 54), 'AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT  ·  CLIMATE CHANGE 2023', f_caption, DIM)

# — Title —
cy = 138
_txt((M, cy), 'CLIMATE CHANGE', f_title, WHITE); cy += 160
_txt((M, cy), '2023', f_title, AMBER); cy += 150
_txt((M, cy), 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report', f_body, CREAM); cy += 50
hrule(cy, M, W-M, DIM, 1); cy += 20
_txt((M, cy), 'CLIMATE SCIENCE CONFERENCE  ·  IPCC AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT DISSEMINATION', f_caption, MUTED); cy += 66

# ═══ SECTION 2: METRICS ════════════════════════════════════════════════

s2y = cy; s2h = 1060
rect(0, s2y, W, s2h, SLATE)
frame(M-12, s2y+12, IW+24, s2h-24, FAINT, 1)

section_head(M, s2y+40, 'ASSESSED METRICS AT A GLANCE', AMBER)
gt = s2y+96

# Registration marks at section start
for rmx in [M-12, W-M+12]:
    sidemark(rmx, s2y+20, RULE)

# Top row — 4 cards
cw4 = (IW - 3*G) // 4
top = [
    ('1.1°C',  'Global surface temperature|increase 2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900', VERMILION),
    ('410 ppm','Atmospheric CO₂ concentration|in 2019 — highest in 2 million years', AMBER),
    ('~59',    'Total global GHG emissions|in 2019 (GtCO₂-equivalent)', AMBER),
    ('~500',   'Remaining carbon budget for|1.5°C, 50% likelihood, from 2020', TEAL),
]
for i, (n,l,c) in enumerate(top):
    stat_card(M+i*(cw4+G), gt, cw4, 190, n, l, c)

# Bottom row — 3 cards, center emphasis
br_y = gt + 190 + 28
sw = int(IW * 0.27)
cw = IW - 2*sw - 2*G
bot = [
    ('~0.20 m','Sea level rise|1901–2018', VERMILION, sw, False),
    ('43%',    'Required GHG reduction by|2030 for 1.5°C pathway', DEEP_RED, cw, True),
    ('3.3–3.6','BILLION PEOPLE|exposed to severe climate hazards', DEEP_RED, sw, True),
]
bx = M
for n,l,c,bw,em in bot:
    stat_card(bx, br_y, bw, 230, n, l, c, emph=em)
    bx += bw + G

# Warming stripes
sy = br_y + 230 + 36
sh = 16
_txt((M, sy-24), 'GLOBAL MEAN SURFACE TEMPERATURE ANOMALY', f_label_sm, MUTED)
tright(W-M, sy-24, '1850–2023 · WARMING STRIPES (ED HAWKINS)', f_caption, DIM)
warming_stripes(M, sy, IW, sh, 160)
frame(M-1, sy-1, IW+2, sh+2, DIM, 1)
_txt((M, sy+sh+6), '1850', f_caption, DIM)
tright(W-M, sy+sh+6, '2023', f_caption, DIM)

hrule(s2y+s2h-1, M, W-M, RULE, 1); cy = s2y + s2h

# ═══ SECTION 3: OBSERVED + PROJECTIONS ═════════════════════════════════

s3y = cy; s3h = 1160
rect(0, s3y, W, s3h, NAVY)
section_head(M, s3y+38, 'OBSERVED CHANGES & FUTURE PROJECTIONS', AMBER)
pt = s3y + 94

# Left column — observed indicators
lw = int(IW * 0.44)
_txt((M, pt), 'OBSERVED STATE', f_section, WHITE)

rows = [
    ('Surface temperature rise', '+1.1°C', '2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900'),
    ('Atmospheric CO₂', '410 ppm', '2019; highest in ≥2 million years'),
    ('Global GHG emissions', '~59 GtCO₂e', '2019 total'),
    ('Sea level rise', '~0.20 m', '1901–2018 cumulative'),
    ('Arctic sea ice (Sept.)', '~40% area loss', '1979–2020'),
]

ty = pt + 56; rh = 48
c1, c2, c3 = M, M+int(lw*0.42), M+int(lw*0.70)

# Table header
rect(M, ty, lw, 30, CARD_ALT)
_txt((c1+12, ty+5), 'INDICATOR', f_label_sm, MUTED)
_txt((c2, ty+5), 'OBSERVED VALUE', f_label_sm, MUTED)
_txt((c3, ty+5), 'PERIOD', f_label_sm, MUTED)

for i, (ind, val, ref) in enumerate(rows):
    ry = ty + 34 + i*rh
    if i % 2 == 0:
        rect(M, ry-1, lw, rh, (14,26,44))
    _txt((c1+12, ry+8), ind, f_body_sm, CREAM)
    _txt((c2, ry+8), val, load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 24), AMBER)
    _txt((c3, ry+8), ref, f_label_sm, MUTED)

hrule(ty+34+5*rh+4, M, M+lw, FAINT, 1)

ay = ty + 34 + 5*rh + 30
_txt((M, ay),
    'Every inhabited region now experiences increases in the frequency and',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
_txt((M, ay+26),
    'intensity of extreme weather — heatwaves, heavy precipitation, droughts,',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
_txt((M, ay+52),
    'tropical cyclones — all with clear attribution to human influence.',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

# Right column — SSP projections
rx = M + lw + G*2
_txt((rx, pt), 'FUTURE TRAJECTORIES', f_section, WHITE)
_txt((rx, pt+42),
    'Projected global warming by 2100 under Shared Socioeconomic Pathways',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

spy = pt + 90

]

for i, (ti, v1, v2, desc, clr) in enumerate(rcols):

    rect(rbx, p4, rcw, rch, CARD_BG, radius=8)

rect(0, s5y, W, s5h, NAVY)
section_head(M, s5y+38, 'MITIGATION PATHWAYS & THE NARROWING WINDOW', TEAL)
p5 = s5y + 90
hw = (IW - G)//2

_txt((M, p5), 'EMISSIONS REDUCTION REQUIREMENTS', f_section, WHITE)

r2y = r1y + r1h + 22; r2h = 104
rect(M, r2y, hw, r2h, CARD_BG, radius=8)
accent(M, r2y, hw, AMBER_DIM)

for ci in [

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report — Key Findings
A0 Portrait 3508×4961 px at 150 DPI
Design Philosophy: Empirical Sublime
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

W, H = 3508, 4961
M  = 200  # master margin
IW = W - 2 * M
G  = 32   # column gap

canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), '#0B1D3A')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)

# ── Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY      = (11, 29, 58)
SLATE     = (30, 45, 64)
CARD_BG   = (21, 34, 50)
CARD_ALT  = (18, 30, 46)
CREAM     = (228, 222, 210)
WHITE     = (248, 246, 242)
AMBER     = (232, 168, 56)
AMBER_DIM = (195, 142, 44)
VERMILION = (212, 68, 43)
VERM_DIM  = (185, 56, 34)
DEEP_RED  = (139, 26, 26)
TEAL      = (45, 139, 139)
TEAL_DIM  = (38, 118, 118)
MUTED     = (105, 118, 132)
DIM       = (62, 74, 90)
FAINT     = (38, 48, 64)
RULE      = (48, 58, 76)

# ── Font System ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = '/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts'
def load(name, sz): return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), sz)

# Display hierarchy
f_title      = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 196)
f_mega       = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 210)
f_large_num  = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 126)
f_med_num    = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 84)
f_small_num  = load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 54)
f_section    = load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 48)
f_subsec     = load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 32)
f_subsec_sm  = load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 24)
f_body       = load('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 28)
f_body_sm    = load('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 22)
f_body_xs    = load('InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf', 18)
f_label      = load('Jura-Light.ttf', 20)
f_label_sm   = load('Jura-Light.ttf', 16)
f_caption    = load('Jura-Light.ttf', 14)

# ── Drawing Primitives ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _txt(xy, text, font, fill, anchor='lt'):
    x, y = xy
    if '\n' in text:
        draw.multiline_text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def tcenter(xr, y, text, font, fill):
    """Center text in horizontal range (x0, x1)."""
    b = font.getbbox(text)
    cx = (xr[0] + xr[1]) / 2 - (b[2] - b[0]) / 2
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def tright(x, y, text, font, fill):
    b = font.getbbox(text)
    draw.text((x - (b[2] - b[0]), y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def rect(x, y, w, h, fill, radius=0):
    if radius:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], radius=radius, fill=fill)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([x, y, x+w, y+h], fill=fill)

def hrule(y, x0, x1, color, h=1):
    draw.rectangle([x0, y, x1, y+h], fill=color)

def vrule(x, y0, y1, color, w=1):
    draw.rectangle([x, y0, x+w, y1], fill=color)

def accent(x, y, w, color, h=4):
    rect(x, y, w, h, color)

def dot(x, y, color, r=3):
    rect(x-r, y-r, r*2, r*2, color)

def sidemark(x, y, color):
    """Small right-side registration mark."""
    rect(x, y, 12, 1, color)

# ── Warming Stripes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def warming_stripes(x, y, w, h, n=160):
    palette = [
        (49,110,165),(58,120,168),(67,130,171),(77,140,171),(87,149,169),
        (97,157,166),(108,164,163),(118,171,159),(129,177,155),(140,182,150),
        (151,186,144),(162,189,138),(173,190,132),(183,191,124),(193,190,116),
        (202,188,108),(210,185,100),(218,180,92),(224,174,83),(230,167,73),
        (232,158,64),(231,148,56),(228,138,49),(223,128,43),(212,68,43),
        (203,58,38),(192,48,34),(181,38,30),(170,30,27),(139,26,26),
    ]
    npal = len(palette)
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / (n - 1)
        ci = min(int(t * (npal - 1)), npal - 1)
        px = int(x + i * w / n)
        pw = max(1, int((x + (i + 1) * w / n) - px))
        rect(px, y, pw, h, palette[ci])

# ── Stat Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def stat_card(x, y, w, h, number, label, accent_color, emph=False):
    bg = tuple(max(0, c+10) for c in CARD_BG)
    rect(x, y, w, h, bg, radius=8)
    if emph:
        accent(x, y, w, accent_color, 4)
        rect(x, y+4, w, 3, tuple(min(255, c+60) for c in accent_color))
    pad = 30
    nf = f_large_num if emph else f_med_num
    _txt((x+pad, y+16 if emph else y+12), number, nf, accent_color)
    for i, line in enumerate(label.split('|')):
        _txt((x+pad, y+h-22*(len(label.split('|'))-i)-14), line, f_label_sm, MUTED)

def section_head(x, y, text, accent):
    _txt((x, y), text.upper(), f_label, accent)
    hrule(y+22, x, x+380, accent, 1)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  COMPOSITION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# — Header band —
rect(0, 0, W, 8, AMBER)
rect(0, 8, W, 3, VERMILION)
_txt((M, 36), 'INTERGOVERNMENTAL PANEL ON CLIMATE CHANGE', f_caption, MUTED)
_txt((M, 54), 'AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT  ·  CLIMATE CHANGE 2023', f_caption, DIM)

# — Title —
cy = 138
_txt((M, cy), 'CLIMATE CHANGE', f_title, WHITE); cy += 160
_txt((M, cy), '2023', f_title, AMBER); cy += 150
_txt((M, cy), 'Key Findings from the IPCC Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report', f_body, CREAM); cy += 50
hrule(cy, M, W-M, DIM, 1); cy += 20
_txt((M, cy), 'CLIMATE SCIENCE CONFERENCE  ·  IPCC AR6 SYNTHESIS REPORT DISSEMINATION', f_caption, MUTED); cy += 66

# ═══ SECTION 2: METRICS ════════════════════════════════════════════════

s2y = cy; s2h = 1060
rect(0, s2y, W, s2h, SLATE)
frame(M-12, s2y+12, IW+24, s2h-24, FAINT, 1)

section_head(M, s2y+40, 'ASSESSED METRICS AT A GLANCE', AMBER)
gt = s2y+96

# Registration marks at section start
for rmx in [M-12, W-M+12]:
    sidemark(rmx, s2y+20, RULE)

# Top row — 4 cards
cw4 = (IW - 3*G) // 4
top = [
    ('1.1°C',  'Global surface temperature|increase 2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900', VERMILION),
    ('410 ppm','Atmospheric CO₂ concentration|in 2019 — highest in 2 million years', AMBER),
    ('~59',    'Total global GHG emissions|in 2019 (GtCO₂-equivalent)', AMBER),
    ('~500',   'Remaining carbon budget for|1.5°C, 50% likelihood, from 2020', TEAL),
]
for i, (n,l,c) in enumerate(top):
    stat_card(M+i*(cw4+G), gt, cw4, 190, n, l, c)

# Bottom row — 3 cards, center emphasis
br_y = gt + 190 + 28
sw = int(IW * 0.27)
cw = IW - 2*sw - 2*G
bot = [
    ('~0.20 m','Sea level rise|1901–2018', VERMILION, sw, False),
    ('43%',    'Required GHG reduction by|2030 for 1.5°C pathway', DEEP_RED, cw, True),
    ('3.3–3.6','BILLION PEOPLE|exposed to severe climate hazards', DEEP_RED, sw, True),
]
bx = M
for n,l,c,bw,em in bot:
    stat_card(bx, br_y, bw, 230, n, l, c, emph=em)
    bx += bw + G

# Warming stripes
sy = br_y + 230 + 36
sh = 16
_txt((M, sy-24), 'GLOBAL MEAN SURFACE TEMPERATURE ANOMALY', f_label_sm, MUTED)
tright(W-M, sy-24, '1850–2023 · WARMING STRIPES (ED HAWKINS)', f_caption, DIM)
warming_stripes(M, sy, IW, sh, 160)
frame(M-1, sy-1, IW+2, sh+2, DIM, 1)
_txt((M, sy+sh+6), '1850', f_caption, DIM)
tright(W-M, sy+sh+6, '2023', f_caption, DIM)

hrule(s2y+s2h-1, M, W-M, RULE, 1); cy = s2y + s2h

# ═══ SECTION 3: OBSERVED + PROJECTIONS ═════════════════════════════════

s3y = cy; s3h = 1160
rect(0, s3y, W, s3h, NAVY)
section_head(M, s3y+38, 'OBSERVED CHANGES & FUTURE PROJECTIONS', AMBER)
pt = s3y + 94

# Left column — observed indicators
lw = int(IW * 0.44)
_txt((M, pt), 'OBSERVED STATE', f_section, WHITE)

rows = [
    ('Surface temperature rise', '+1.1°C', '2011–2020 vs. 1850–1900'),
    ('Atmospheric CO₂', '410 ppm', '2019; highest in ≥2 million years'),
    ('Global GHG emissions', '~59 GtCO₂e', '2019 total'),
    ('Sea level rise', '~0.20 m', '1901–2018 cumulative'),
    ('Arctic sea ice (Sept.)', '~40% area loss', '1979–2020'),
]

ty = pt + 56; rh = 48
c1, c2, c3 = M, M+int(lw*0.42), M+int(lw*0.70)

# Table header
rect(M, ty, lw, 30, CARD_ALT)
_txt((c1+12, ty+5), 'INDICATOR', f_label_sm, MUTED)
_txt((c2, ty+5), 'OBSERVED VALUE', f_label_sm, MUTED)
_txt((c3, ty+5), 'PERIOD', f_label_sm, MUTED)

for i, (ind, val, ref) in enumerate(rows):
    ry = ty + 34 + i*rh
    if i % 2 == 0:
        rect(M, ry-1, lw, rh, (14,26,44))
    _txt((c1+12, ry+8), ind, f_body_sm, CREAM)
    _txt((c2, ry+8), val, load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 24), AMBER)
    _txt((c3, ry+8), ref, f_label_sm, MUTED)

hrule(ty+34+5*rh+4, M, M+lw, FAINT, 1)

ay = ty + 34 + 5*rh + 30
_txt((M, ay),
    'Every inhabited region now experiences increases in the frequency and',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
_txt((M, ay+26),
    'intensity of extreme weather — heatwaves, heavy precipitation, droughts,',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
_txt((M, ay+52),
    'tropical cyclones — all with clear attribution to human influence.',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

# Right column — SSP projections
rx = M + lw + G*2
_txt((rx, pt), 'FUTURE TRAJECTORIES', f_section, WHITE)
_txt((rx, pt+42),
    'Projected global warming by 2100 under Shared Socioeconomic Pathways',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

spy = pt + 90
ssps = [
    ('SSP1-1.9', '~1.4°C', 'Very low emissions · sustainability', TEAL, 1.4),
    ('SSP1-2.6', '~1.8°C', 'Low emissions pathway', (88,168,140), 1.8),
    ('SSP2-4.5', '~2.7°C', 'Intermediate emissions pathway', AMBER, 2.7),
    ('SSP3-7.0', '~3.6°C', 'High emissions pathway', (208,112,54), 3.6),
    ('SSP5-8.5', '~4.4°C', 'Very high · fossil-fuel intensive', DEEP_RED, 4.4),
]

rw = IW - lw - G*2
rect(rx, spy, rw, len(ssps)*66+34, CARD_ALT, radius=8)
dx = rx + 32
dw = rw - 64

# Diverging bars — scientific instrument aesthetic
for idx, (name, temp, desc, clr, val) in enumerate(ssps):
    ry2 = spy + 18 + idx*66

    # Bar representing warming magnitude relative to scale
    bar_y = ry2 + 30
    bar_h = 8
    bar_max = dw - 140

    frac = (val - 0.8) / 4.0
    bw = int(24 + frac * (bar_max - 24))

    # Trail (faded approach)
    trail = int(bw * 0.3)
    for ti in range(trail):
        a = 0.12 + 0.88 * (ti/trail)
        fc = tuple(max(0, min(255, int(c*a))) for c in clr)
        rect(dx+ti, bar_y, 1, bar_h, fc)

    # Main bar
    rect(dx+trail, bar_y, bw-trail, bar_h, clr)
    # Terminal marker
    rect(dx+bw-4, bar_y-4, 8, bar_h+8, clr)

    # Labels
    _txt((dx, ry2-2), name, load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 22), clr)
    _txt((dx+bw+14, ry2-2), temp, load('BigShoulders-Bold.ttf', 28), clr)
    _txt((dx, ry2+44), desc, f_label_sm, MUTED)

# Sea level projection note
sln = spy + len(ssps)*66 + 48
_txt((rx, sln),
    'Sea level rise by 2100: 0.28–0.55 m (SSP1-1.9)  ·  0.63–1.01 m (SSP5-8.5)',
    f_body_sm, CREAM)
_txt((rx, sln+28),
    'Continued rise for centuries to millennia regardless of emissions pathway.',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

hrule(s3y+s3h-1, M, W-M, RULE, 1); cy = s3y + s3h

# ═══ SECTION 4: RISKS ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

s4y = cy; s4h = 690
rect(0, s4y, W, s4h, SLATE)
section_head(M, s4y+38, 'RISKS, VULNERABILITIES & CASCADING IMPACTS', VERMILION)
p4 = s4y + 90

rcols = [
    ('EXPOSED\nPOPULATION',  '3.3–3.6', 'BILLION',
     'People in contexts highly|vulnerable to climate|change impacts', AMBER),
    ('BIODIVERSITY\nLOSS',    'UP TO 14%', '',
     'Terrestrial species at|very high extinction risk|at 1.5°C of warming', VERMILION),
    ('FOOD & WATER\nSECURITY','HALF OF', 'POPULATION',
     'Experiences severe water|scarcity ≥ 1 month/year.|Crop yields slowing.', DEEP_RED),
    ('HEALTH\nIMPACTS',      'EXPANDING', '',
     'Heat-related mortality|rising. Vector-borne|disease ranges growing.', VERMILION),
]

rcw = (IW - 3*G)//4; rch = 300
for i, (ti, v1, v2, desc, clr) in enumerate(rcols):
    rbx = M + i*(rcw+G)
    rect(rbx, p4, rcw, rch, CARD_BG, radius=8)
    accent(rbx, p4, rcw, clr)

    pd = 24
    _txt((rbx+pd, p4+22), ti, load('InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf', 20), WHITE)
    _txt((rbx+pd, p4+92), v1, f_med_num, clr)
    if v2:
        _txt((rbx+pd, p4+154), v2, f_subsec_sm, clr)
    _txt((rbx+pd, p4+188), desc, f_body_xs, CREAM)

# Cascading risks
cry = p4 + rch + 32
_txt((M, cry), 'CASCADING & COMPOUNDING RISKS', f_subsec, WHITE)
_txt((M, cry+40),
    'Climate hazards interact with poverty, inequality, and ecosystem degradation to',
    f_body, CREAM)
_txt((M, cry+72),
    'produce cascading and compounding impacts across interconnected systems — food,',
    f_body, CREAM)
_txt((M, cry+104),
    'water, health, infrastructure, and biodiversity — affecting the most vulnerable most severely.',
    f_body_sm, MUTED)

hrule(s4y+s4h-1, M, W-M, RULE, 1); cy = s4y + s4h

# ═══ SECTION 5: MITIGATION + NARROWING WINDOW ══════════════════════════

s5y = cy; s5h = 870
rect(0, s5y, W, s5h, NAVY)
section_head(M, s5y+38, 'MITIGATION PATHWAYS & THE NARROWING WINDOW', TEAL)
p5 = s5y + 90
hw = (IW - G)//2

# — Left: Mitigation Requirements —
_txt((M, p5), 'EMISSIONS REDUCTION REQUIREMENTS', f_section, WHITE)

r1y = p5 + 60; r1h = 136
rect(M, r1y, hw, r1h, CARD_BG, radius=8)
accent(M, r1y, hw, TEAL)
_txt((M+32, r1y+20), 'TO LIMIT WARMING TO 1.5°C', f_label, AMBER)
_txt((M+32, r1y+46), '43%', f_large_num, DEEP_RED)
_txt((M+170, r1y+58), 'reduction below 2019 levels by 2030', f_body, CREAM)
_txt((M+32, r1y+108), 'Net zero CO₂ by around 2050  ·  ~500 GtCO₂ remaining budget', f_body_sm, MUTED)

r2y = r1y + r1h + 22; r2h = 104
rect(M, r2y, hw, r2h, CARD_BG, radius=8)
accent(M, r2y, hw, AMBER_DIM)
_txt((M+32, r2y+20), 'TO LIMIT WARMING TO 2°C', f_label, MUTED)
_txt((M+32, r2y+42), '27%', f_med_num, AMBER)
_txt((M+140, r2y+52), 'reduction below 2019 levels by 2030', f_body, CREAM)
_txt((M+32, r2y+82), 'Net zero CO₂ by around 2070', f_body_sm, MUTED)

# Key levers
ly = r2y + r2h + 30
_txt((M, ly), 'KEY MITIGATION LEVERS', f_subsec, WHITE)
levers = [
    'Rapid decarbonization of energy systems',
    'Electrification of transport',
    'Demand-side efficiency improvements',
    'Protection and restoration of carbon sinks',
]
for i, lev in enumerate(levers):
    col = M+16 if i%2==0 else M+hw//2+16
    rowy = ly+32+(i//2)*28
    dot(col-14, rowy+10, TEAL, 3)
    _txt((col, rowy), lev, f_body_sm, CREAM)

# — Right: Narrowing Window —
rx5 = M + hw + G
_txt((rx5, p5), 'THE NARROWING WINDOW', f_section, VERMILION)

wy = p5 + 60; wh = 380
